schema:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.label: Missed time limit before the EPO: legal consequence and remedy
schema:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.beschreibung: The basic grid of almost every Paper D question: calculate the time limit, establish the legal consequence, then check in a fixed order whether further processing is available, otherwise re-establishment of rights, and whether other routes help (decision under R. 112(2) EPC, extension of the time limit, legitimate expectations, new application).

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.label: 1. Determine the time limit (Art. 120 EPC, R. 131 EPC)

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.1.label: 1. Triggering event and duration
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.1.text: Notification (R. 126(2) and 127(2) EPC: date of the document), date of filing or priority, mention in the Bulletin; duration from the Convention, the Implementing Regulations or the communication.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.2.label: 2. Calculate the expiry (R. 131(4) EPC)
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.2.text: A period in months expires on the day with the same number, otherwise on the last day of the month; for chains of time limits, always calculate from the original event.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.3.label: 3. Extension (R. 134 EPC)
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.1.3.text: Filing office closed or electronic filing unavailable: next day on which all filing offices are open (R. 134(1) EPC); general interruption of the mail (R. 134(2) EPC); exceptional occurrence in the last ten days (R. 134(5) EPC).

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.2.label: 2. Legal consequence of the failure
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.2.text: Application deemed to be withdrawn (e.g. Art. 86(1) and 94(4) EPC, R. 71(7) EPC), loss of a right (priority, R. 53(3) EPC), document deemed not to have been filed; communication under R. 112(1) EPC.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.1.label: 1. Available?
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.1.text: Time limit vis-à-vis the EPO, missed by the applicant; not ruled out under Art. 121(4) EPC or R. 135(2) EPC.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.2.label: 2. Time limit: two months after the communication (R. 135(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.2.text: Communication of the failure to observe a time limit or of the loss of rights; calculate the expiry under R. 131 EPC.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.3.label: 3. Pay the fee and complete the omitted act
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.3.3.text: The request is deemed to be filed only on payment; without the omitted act completed it is inadmissible. No fault to be examined.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.label: 4. Re-establishment of rights (Art. 122 EPC, R. 136 EPC)

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.1.label: 1. Available?
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.1.text: Only if further processing is not available (R. 136(3) EPC); direct loss of rights; applicant, proprietor, exceptionally the opponent (G 1/86).

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.2.label: 2. Time limit (R. 136(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.2.text: Two months after removal of the cause of non-compliance, at the latest one year after expiry of the missed time limit; priority period and time limit for the petition for review: two months after their expiry.

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.3.label: 3. Form: request, fee, grounds, completing the omitted act (R. 136(1) and 136(2) EPC)
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.3.text: All grounds and means of evidence immediately (J 6/22).

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.4.label: 4. Well founded: all due care
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.4.4.text: Isolated mistake within a normally satisfactory system for monitoring time limits; due care of the applicant, the representative and assistants (J 5/80).

step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.5.label: 5. Other routes
step:epc_schema_fristversaeumnis.5.text: Request a decision open to appeal if the loss of rights is disputed (R. 112(2) EPC); divisional application as long as the application is pending; new application (without priority if its period has expired); legitimate expectations.

schema:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.label: Novelty in Paper D: effective date and state of the art
schema:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.beschreibung: For each claim, first determine the effective date (priority, partial priority), then classify each document: Art. 54(2) EPC, Art. 54(3) EPC or no state of the art at all, and finally check the remedies.

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.1.1.label: 1. Requirements for priority
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.1.1.text: First application (Art. 87(4) EPC), Paris Convention or WTO state, twelve-month period, same invention (G 2/98), entitlement (G 1/22), declaration (R. 52 EPC).

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.1.2.label: 2. Partial priority (Art. 88(3) EPC, G 1/15)
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.1.2.text: Split generic claims: disclosed part at the date of priority, remainder at the date of filing.

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.1.label: 1. Art. 54(2) EPC
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.1.text: Made available to the public before the effective date, regardless of where and in which language; including the applicant's own publications.

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.2.label: 2. Art. 54(3) EPC
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.2.text: Earlier European (or Euro-PCT under R. 165 EPC) application, earlier effective date, published on or after the relevant date; novelty only.

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.3.label: 3. No state of the art
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.2.3.text: Published after the effective date and not Art. 54(3) EPC; national prior rights (Art. 139(2) EPC); non-prejudicial disclosure (Art. 55 EPC).

step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.3.label: 3. Remedies
step:epc_schema_stand_der_technik.3.text: Disclaimer against Art. 54(3) EPC (G 1/03), divisional application or limitation to the part entitled to priority, re-establishment in respect of the priority period, opposition against the earlier patent.

schema:epc_schema_einspruch.label: Opposition: admissibility and merits (Art. 99 to 101 EPC)
schema:epc_schema_einspruch.beschreibung: Admissibility in the order of the examination for deficiencies under R. 77 EPC, then the merits; in addition intervention and continuation of the proceedings by the EPO of its own motion.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.1.label: 1. Available
step:epc_schema_einspruch.1.text: Granted European patent; also after surrender or lapse (R. 75 EPC); pending limitation proceedings are no obstacle.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.2.label: 2. Opponent
step:epc_schema_einspruch.2.text: Any third party, even a straw man (G 3/97), not the proprietor (G 9/93); several persons jointly with one fee (G 3/99); representation under Art. 133(2) EPC.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.3.label: 3. Time limit and fee (Art. 99(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_einspruch.3.text: Nine months after the mention of grant; fee within the same period, otherwise the opposition is deemed not to have been filed; no further processing (not an applicant), no re-establishment for the opponent.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.4.label: 4. Content (R. 76(2) EPC)
step:epc_schema_einspruch.4.text: Particulars of the opponent and of the patent, extent, grounds, facts and evidence; deficiencies under R. 77 EPC partly remediable only within the opposition period.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.5.label: 5. Merits (Art. 100 and 101 EPC)
step:epc_schema_einspruch.5.text: Only the grounds of Art. 100 EPC; scope of examination G 9/91, G 10/91; amended claims: Art. 84 EPC only insofar as caused by the amendment (G 3/14), Art. 123(2) and 123(3) EPC.

step:epc_schema_einspruch.6.label: 6. Intervention and continuation
step:epc_schema_einspruch.6.text: Intervention of the assumed infringer within three months (Art. 105 EPC, R. 89 EPC); continuation by the EPO of its own motion after withdrawal or death (R. 84 EPC).

schema:epc_schema_beschwerde.label: Appeal: admissibility (Art. 106 to 108 EPC)
schema:epc_schema_beschwerde.beschreibung: Examination of the admissibility of an appeal in the order of R. 101 EPC, with interlocutory revision and reimbursement of the fee.

step:epc_schema_beschwerde.1.label: 1. Decision open to appeal (Art. 106 EPC)
step:epc_schema_beschwerde.1.text: Decision of the Receiving Section, an Examining or Opposition Division or the Legal Division; interlocutory decisions only together with the final decision, unless the decision allows a separate appeal (Art. 106(2) EPC).

step:epc_schema_beschwerde.2.label: 2. Entitlement to appeal (Art. 107 EPC)
step:epc_schema_beschwerde.2.text: A party adversely affected; the other parties are parties to the appeal proceedings as of right. An intervener at the appeal stage is not an appellant (G 2/24).

step:epc_schema_beschwerde.3.label: 3. Time limit and fee (first and second sentences of Art. 108 EPC)
step:epc_schema_beschwerde.3.text: Two months after notification; both in time, otherwise the appeal is deemed not to have been filed (G 1/18).

step:epc_schema_beschwerde.4.label: 4. Form and grounds (R. 99 EPC, third sentence of Art. 108 EPC)
step:epc_schema_beschwerde.4.text: Name and address of the appellant (correction under R. 101(2) EPC, G 1/12), contested decision, request; statement of grounds within four months.

step:epc_schema_beschwerde.5.label: 5. Interlocutory revision and reimbursement (Art. 109 EPC, R. 103 EPC)
step:epc_schema_beschwerde.5.text: Interlocutory revision only in ex parte proceedings; reimbursement of the appeal fee under R. 103 EPC (competence G 3/03).

schema:epc_schema_euro_pct.label: Euro-PCT: entry into the European phase (R. 159 EPC)
schema:epc_schema_euro_pct.beschreibung: The 31-month time limit and the acts under R. 159(1) EPC, the consequences of missing them and the procedure after entry.

step:epc_schema_euro_pct.1.label: 1. Time limit: 31 months from the date of filing or the earliest date of priority (R. 159(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_euro_pct.1.text: Calculation of the time limit under R. 131 EPC; early processing on express request (Art. 23(2) PCT).

step:epc_schema_euro_pct.2.label: 2. Acts (R. 159(1)(a) to 159(1)(h) EPC)
step:epc_schema_euro_pct.2.text: Translation, specification of the application documents, filing fee, designation fee, search fee, request for examination, renewal fee for the third year, exhibition certificate.

step:epc_schema_euro_pct.3.label: 3. Failure (R. 160 EPC)
step:epc_schema_euro_pct.3.text: Application deemed to be withdrawn or designation deemed to be withdrawn; communication under R. 112(1) EPC, then further processing; translation missing: further processing as well.

step:epc_schema_euro_pct.4.label: 4. After entry
step:epc_schema_euro_pct.4.text: Invitation under R. 161 EPC (comments/amendments within six months), claims fees R. 162 EPC, lack of unity R. 164 EPC, state of the art under Art. 54(3) EPC via R. 165 EPC.

schema:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.label: Divisional application: requirements and fees (Art. 76 EPC, R. 36 EPC)
schema:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.beschreibung: When a divisional application is still possible, where and in which language it must be filed, what content it may have and which fees are payable.

step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.1.label: 1. Pending parent application (R. 36(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.1.text: Until the day before the mention of grant; after refusal until expiry of the time limit for appeal (G 1/09); not during the time limit for re-establishment after a loss of rights (J 4/11); Euro-PCT only after entry (J 18/09).

step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.2.label: 2. Applicant, place, language (R. 36(2) EPC)
step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.2.text: Applicant of the parent application; filing with the EPO in Munich, The Hague or Berlin; language of the proceedings of the parent application or its original language with a translation.

step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.3.label: 3. Content (Art. 76(1) EPC)
step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.3.text: Not beyond the parent application (G 1/05); in a sequence, not beyond any predecessor (G 1/06); no double patenting (G 4/19).

step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.4.label: 4. Fees
step:epc_schema_teilanmeldung.4.text: Filing fee and search fee within one month (R. 36(3) EPC), designation fee under R. 36(4) EPC, renewal fees already due within four months (R. 51(3) EPC).
